# 从市场抽身，自建平台：这对程序员如何把收入做到每月4.5万美元

![封面图](https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/I94w6dp05PXqiFipPtGF/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/headerImage)

2011年，有两个程序员。

在印度。

一个叫Vrushank，一个叫他的伙伴。

他们在同一家软件公司上班。

发现了一个问题——

每个项目都需要后台管理面板。

但没有好用的现成方案。

每次都要从零写UI。

耗时，重复，无聊。

他们问：为什么我们不自己建一套？

这就是ThemeSelection的开始。

不是宏大的vision。

只是解决自己的pain。

**【在市场验证，再离开市场】**

他们先在Envato的ThemeForest上launch了一个产品。

验证需求。

现在每个月还能从市场拿1.5-2万美元。

但 pivotal 的决定是——

建自己的平台。

ThemeSelection.com。

为什么？

完全控制用户体验。

完全控制定价。

完全控制营销策略。

和用户的直接互动是关键。

**【20人团队，40+产品】**

现在他们有20多人团队。

提供 fully-coded 的管理后台模板和UI Kits。

给设计师、开发者、机构——

 kickstart 项目，

节省时间、钱、精力、资源。

40+个 premium 和免费产品。

支持不同技术栈——

Laravel、Vue、NextJS、NuxtJS、

.NET Core MVC、Razor Pages……

每月收入2.5-3万美元。

加上市场的1.5-2万，

总共4-4.5万美元。

**【一次性购买，终身使用】**

所有产品都是一次性购买。

每次购买包含一年免费更新和 premium 支持——

可以按年续。

类似永久授权。

买了就终身可用。

授权结构很灵活。

竞争对手提供两种授权，

他们提供四种。

因为每个客户需求不同。

客户 appreciate 这种灵活性，

转化率更高。

**【三个改变游戏的产品】**

2022年是他们的大年。

发布了三个改变游戏的产品。

两个——Sneat和Materio——

 comprehensive 设计系统，

覆盖各种用户设计偏好。

然后他们发现——

客户在用多种技术，

想买多个产品。

于是有了 Big Bundle（大礼包）的主意。

客户可以用差不多两个产品的价格，

拿到所有 premium 产品。

对客户好，

对他们也好——

大礼包占总收入40-45%。

他们总结了两步建 changer 的方法：

1. 识别和解决用户最普遍的需求。

   看使用模式就知道。

2. 通过灵活定价或 bundle 包，

   让各规模客户都能 access。

**【SEO第一】**

怎么增长？

Focus on SEO。

最大化 organic traffic。

用Semrush和Ubersuggest确定目标关键词——

找到和受众、产品解决方案都相关的搜索词。

然后发布 helpful、informative 的博客文章，

吸引流量，建立客户群。

另一个SEO play——

给设计师和开发者建免费工具。

比如免费UI kits、Bootstrap 5 CheatSheet。

双赢——带来大量相关、高质量流量。

现在流量每月28万访问，

40%来自 organic search。

另外42%直接访问。

**【开发者社区】**

除了SEO，

他们还花很多时间在开发者和设计师社区——

DevTo、Medium、Hackernoon。

在这些社区建内容、engage，

显著提升了品牌认知度。

现在DevTo上6000+粉丝，

Medium上1000+。

到处 submit 产品。

把开源产品放GitHub、Awesome List、

其他开源社区——

对建立客户群 huge。

现在GitHub总共3600+ stars，

还在快速增长。

也提交到常规平台——

Reddit、Facebook、Twitter、

Discord、Dribbble、Instagram、LinkedIn。

**【免费用户是long game】**

今天竞争激烈，

转化流量不容易。

你得用 freemium 或试用建立信任。

ThemeSelection有30+免费（开源）产品。

不只是信任。

很多startup和企业最初用免费产品建工具。

随着成长、evolve，需求也 evolve。

这是 long game。

他们见过用免费版 hang around 好几年的人，

最终 decided 升级 premium。

很酷。

当然，不是所有拿 freebie 的都 jump to premium。

他们的情况是——

每月5500免费下载，

大约250人决定转换。

转化率约4.55%。

除了钱，

这个策略还能 gauge interest、

获得 valuable feedback。

**【付费推广的教训】**

他们试过在各种开发者和设计师相关网站做付费推广——

MadewithVuejs、SitePoint、MadewithLaravel。

也试过Meta ads。

结果还行，

但 organic search 和 sales 更好。

付费营销不坏，

但信任是通过提供质量 earned 的，

不是通过广告 spend。

如果要做广告实验，

确保为单个平台建多个广告 campaign，

分析数据决定哪些 engagement 更好。

避免基于短期结果做决策。

 gather 至少两个季度的ROI数据再决定。

**【质量是他们的护城河】**

什么让他们 stand out from competition？

质量。

他们想scale，

但不愿牺牲让他们 stand out 的东西。

所以他们不怕把质量和客户满意放在 sheer size 之前。

事实上，这就是他们 grow 的方式。

赢得了 loyal following 和 solid reputation。

总是从市场研究开始。

参加最新设计会议，

 engage 社区，

保持 feedback loop buzzing，

确保他们 ahead of the curve。

平均每个产品花6到12个月 build，

确保设计和代码质量。

而且不外包。

另一部分是他们 focus on support。

用Intercom提供 real-time support，

还建了 help center，

30+篇文章，

客户可以搜索关于支付、产品、授权等的 query。

说到底，

不是关于变得更大，

而是关于变得更好。

**【你想控制你的生意吗？】**

ThemeSelection的故事告诉我们——

第三方市场是好起点，

但真正的 control 和 growth，

来自自建平台。

你可以控制用户体验。

你可以控制定价。

你可以控制营销策略。

你可以直接和客户对话。

这需要更多工作——

自己的网站、

自己的支付、

自己的客服、

自己的营销。

但回报也是巨大的。

从市场的1.5-2万，

到自己平台的2.5-3万。

你呢？

还在依赖第三方平台吗？

还是准备建自己的渠道了？

*P.S. 想要好看的管理后台模板？

themeselection.com看看。

说不定你的下一个项目，

就不用从零写UI了。*

Getting out of the market and building your own platform: How programmers can make their own income reach $45,000 a month

In 2011, there were two programmers.

In India.

One called Vrushank and the other called his partner.

They work for the same software company.

A problem was discovered--

Every project requires a backend management panel.

But there is no ready-made solution that works well.

Write the UI from scratch every time.

Time consuming, repetitive, boring.

They asked: Why don't we build one ourselves?

This is the beginning of ThemeSelection.

Not a grand vision.

Just solve your pain.

[Verify in the market and then leave the market]

They first launched a product on Envato's ThemeForest.

Verify requirements.

Now you can still get US$15,000 to US$20,000 per month from the market.

But pivotal's decision was--

Build your own platform.

ThemeSelection.com。

Why?

Full control of the user experience.

Full control of pricing.

Full control of marketing strategies.

Direct interaction with users is key.

[Team of 20 people, 40+ products]

Now they have a team of more than 20 people.

Provide full-coded management back-end templates and UI Kits.

For designers, developers, institutions--

 kickstart project,

Save time, money, energy, and resources.

40+ premium and free products.

Support different technology stacks--

Laravel、Vue、NextJS、NuxtJS、

.NET Core MVC、Razor Pages……

Monthly income is US$25,000-US$30,000.

Add in the market of 15,000 - 20,000,

A total of US$40,000 to US$45,000.

[One-time purchase, lifetime use]

All products are purchased once.

Each purchase includes a year of free updates and premium support--

Can be renewed annually.

Similar to permanent authorization.

Buy it and you can use it for life.

The authorization structure is flexible.

Competitors offer two authorizations,

They offer four.

Because each customer has different needs.

Customers appreciate this flexibility,

The conversion rate is higher.

[Three game-changing products]

2022 is their new year.

Three game-changing products were released.

two--Sneat and Materio--

 Comprehensive design system,

Covering various user design preferences.

And then they found out--

Customers are using multiple technologies,

Want to buy multiple products.

So came the idea of a Big Bundle.

Customers can use the price of almost two products,

Get all premium products.

Be good to customers,

It's also good for them--

Gift packages account for 40-45% of total revenue.

They summarized a two-step method to build a changer:

1. Identify and address the most common needs of users.

   Look at the usage pattern.

2. Through flexible pricing or bundle packages,

   Provide access to customers of all sizes.

[SEO First]

How to grow?

Focus on SEO。

Maximize organic traffic.

Use Semrush and Ubersuggest to determine target keywords--

Find search terms that are relevant to your audience and product solutions.

Then publish helpful and informative blog posts,

Attract traffic and build a customer base.

Another SEO play--

Build free tools for designers and developers.

For example, free UI kits and Bootstrap 5 Cheat Sheet.

Win-win-bringing a large amount of relevant and high-quality traffic.

Now traffic is 280,000 visits per month,

40% comes from organic search.

Another 42% visited directly.

[Developer Community]

Besides SEO,

They also spend a lot of time in the developer and designer community--

DevTo、Medium、Hackernoon。

Build content, engage, and

Significantly improved brand recognition.

Now DevTo has 6000+ fans,

1000+ on Medium.

Submit products everywhere.

Put open source products on GitHub, Awesome List,

Other open source communities--

Huge to build a customer base.

GitHub now has a total of 3600+ stars,

It is still growing rapidly.

Also submitted to regular platforms--

Reddit、Facebook、Twitter、

Discord、Dribbble、Instagram、LinkedIn。

[Free users are long game]

Competition is fierce today,

Converting traffic is not easy.

You have to use freemium or try it out to build trust.

ThemeSelection has 30+ free (open source) products.

Not just trust.

Many startups and businesses initially built tools with free products.

As you grow and evolve, demand also evolves.

This is a long game.

They have seen people who have used the free version of hang around for several years.

Finally decided to upgrade premium.

It's cool.

Of course, not everyone with freebie jumps to premium.

Their situation is--

0 free downloads per month,

About 250 people decided to switch.

The conversion rate is about 4.55%.

Besides money,

This strategy can also gauge interest,

Get valuable feedback.

[Lessons from paid promotion]

They have tried paid promotions on various developer and designer websites--

MadewithVuejs、SitePoint、MadewithLaravel。

I also tried Meta ads.

The results were okay,

But organic search and sales are better.

Paid marketing is not bad,

But trust is earned by providing quality,

Not through advertising.

If you want to experiment in advertising,

Make sure you build multiple ad campaigns for a single platform,

Analyze data to determine which engagement is better.

Avoid making decisions based on short-term results.

 Gather will decide on ROI data for at least two quarters.

[Quality is their moat]

What makes them stand out from competition?

Quality.

They want to scale,

But they are unwilling to sacrifice what makes them stand out.

So they are not afraid to put quality and customer satisfaction before the sheer size.

In fact, this is the way they grow.

Won loyal following and solid reputation.

Always start with market research.

Attend the latest design conference,

 engage community,

Keep feedback loop buzzing,

Make sure they are ahead of the curve.

On average, each product takes 6 to 12 months to build,

Ensure design and code quality.

And it does not outsource.

The other part is that they focus on support.

Use Intercom to provide real-time support,

Also built a help center,

30+ articles,

Customers can search for queries about payments, products, authorizations, etc.

After all,

It's not about getting bigger,

It's about getting better.

[Do you want to control your business?]

The story of ThemeSelection tells us--

party markets are a good starting point,

But real control and growth,

From self-built platforms.

You can control the user experience.

You can control pricing.

You can control your marketing strategy.

You can talk directly to customers.

This requires more work--

own website,

own payments,

your own customer service,

your own marketing.

But the rewards are also huge.

From the market of 0 to 0,

To 25,000 - 30,000 yuan on their own platform.

What about you?

Still relying on third-party platforms?

Or are you ready to build your own channel?

*P.S. Want a nice management backend template?

Take a look at themeselection.com.

Maybe your next project,

You don't have to write the UI from scratch. *

ThemeSelection.com.

مماثلة لتفويض دائم.

تشتري وتستخدم مدى الحياة.

ومرونة هيكل السلطة.

ويقدم المنافسون نوعين من التفويضات،

ويقدم أربعة أنواع.

لأن احتياجات كل عميل مختلفة.

العملاء يقدرون هذه المرونة،

معدل تحويل أعلى.

ثلاثة منتجات تغيرت اللعبة

تم إصدار ثلاثة منتجات تغير اللعبة.

اثنان - سنات و ماتيريو -

 نظام التصميم الشامل،

تغطية مجموعة متنوعة من تفضيلات تصميم المستخدمين.

يستخدم العملاء مجموعة متنوعة من التقنيات،

أدوات مجانية للمصممين والمطورين.

على سبيل المثال ، مجموعات UI مجانية ، Bootstrap 5 CheatSheet.

40٪ من البحث العضوي.

[مجتمع المطورين]

DevTo و Medium و Hackernoon.

Reddit, Facebook, Twitter,

Discord ، Dribbble ، Instagram ، LinkedIn.

تحويل التدفقات ليس سهلا.

يجب عليك استخدام freemium أو التجربة لبناء الثقة.

مع النمو والتطور ، تتطور الطلبات أيضًا.

باستثناء المال،

هذه الاستراتيجية يمكن أيضا قياس الاهتمام،

MadewithVuejs، SitePoint، MadewithLaravel.

ولكن الثقة التي اكتسبت من خلال تقديم الجودة،

لا تنفق من خلال الإعلان.

 جمع بيانات عائد الاستثمار لمدة ربعين على الأقل.

الجودة.

 إشراك المجتمع المحلي،
